bug_semantics:
GitConfigParser._write()/write_section() re-serializes resident config values by replacing embedded newlines with a physical newline plus tab (str(value).replace('
','
	') / later _value_to_string(v).replace('
','
	')). Git does not treat an indentation-only next line as a value continuation unless the previous line ends in a backslash, so a previously decoded multi-line quoted value (standard git 
 escape + backslash-continuation, inert on disk) becomes independent config lines after any unrelated GitPython write. An attacker-shaped dormant value such as A
hooksPath = ../evil-hooks becomes a live core.hooksPath, enabling hook RCE on the next hook-firing git operation.
flaw_origin:
The unsafe serialize was first written in 3fd37230e76a014cf5c45d55daf0be2caa6948b7 ('implemented config class as far as necessary...'), which added GitConfigParser._write/write_section to lib/git/config.py with fp.write("	%s = %s
" % (key, str(value).replace('
', '
	'))). Immediate parent 9513aa01fab73f53e4fe18644c7d5b530a66c6a1 is only a config-reader frame with no _write, write_section, or newline-replace. Later commits (345d6be7 _read override, b825dc74 string_decode/unicode_escape multi-line read, df951491 _value_to_string, f7bbe6b0 multi-value, 21ec5299 black quote restyle, c417af46 setter-only CR/LF/NUL reject) moved or wrapped that same write; they did not introduce it. First-party GHSA-284h-m62q-gf8w names the read-then-corrupt-on-rewrite and cites 4b4e47fc as the 3.1.59 serialize fix.

First-party GHSA-284h-m62q-gf8w (https://github.com/gitpython-developers/GitPython/security/advisories/GHSA-284h-m62q-gf8w): dormant multi-line git-config values corrupted into live directives (e.g. core.hooksPath) on any unrelated GitConfigParser write; pip <= 3.1.58, patched >= 3.1.59; sink git/config.py _read string_decode plus _write/write_section .replace("
","
	"). GitHub GHSA-9557-234j-7rv9 aliases CVE-2026-78676, withdrawn_at=null. CVE.org CVE-2026-78676 PUBLISHED (assigner VulnCheck, datePublished 2026-08-25T01:30:33Z, not rejected); affected 0 <= version < 3.1.59, 3.1.59 unaffected. git log --all --reverse -S "replace('

	')" -- '*.py' first hit 3fd37230e76a014cf5c45d55daf0be2caa6948b7 (2009-10-19) adding lib/git/config.py _write line 265. git rev-list --parents -n 1 3fd37230: single parent 9513aa01fab73f53e4fe18644c7d5b530a66c6a1. git grep replace/write_section/def _write on that parent lib/git/config.py: no matches (frame only, 100 lines). Subsequent history of the same line: 04357d0d encode(defenc); df951491 _value_to_string wrap; f7bbe6b0 multi-value loop; 21ec5299/e5305445 black restyle; none change the newline-to-physical-line semantics. 4b4e47fc1224e23b0c8ee7220a7192818f2e4abb (parent 9729ed3b948f2bde09f1f188c5311e172212b67e) replaces the replace with quoted Git-style 
 escapes; message 'This addresses GHSA-284h-m62q-gf8w'; ancestor of tag 3.1.59=66340d77aab9a7468f4aed3681d4ef1e3c0ec931 not of 3.1.58. 3.1.59 git/config.py:708-712 uses quoted continuation serialize. c417af46 is setter-only and explicitly preserves multiline read; 4c260e46 rewrite is not an ancestor of 3.1.58. 3fd37230 author/committer Sebastian Thiel <byronimo@gmail.com> 2009-10-19, empty trailers. 4b4e47fc Assisted-by/Co-authored-by GPT 5.6 is the fix, not the BIC.
reasoning: The vulnerability is GitPython's writer emitting embedded newlines as physical indented lines that Git parses as new keys, not the later setter CR/LF/NUL guard and not the 2015 multi-line reader. 3fd37230 is the smallest public first-write of that serialize; the parent tree has no _write. Path moves (lib/git/config.py -> git/config.py) and black/encode/_value_to_string refactors are not BICs. b825dc74 made dormant quoted \n values decode into real LFs that then hit the already-present writer, expanding reachability, but the flawed mechanism is the writer first written in 3fd37230. 4b4e47fc is the advisory-named atomic fix and first-lands in 3.1.59, matching CVE/GHSA-284h. CVE.org remains PUBLISHED, so not FALSE_POSITIVE. AI judgment is BIC-only: 2009 human author/committer with no commit-object AI marker. GPT 5.6 on 4b4e47fc and GPT 5.5 on c417af46 do not attribute introduction.
